camel_example: aliyun cloud-siem DescribeCloudSiemEvents --region cn-hangzhou --Status 0 --Order desc --ThreadLevel.1 remind --EndTime 1577808000000 --PageSize 10 --RoleType 1 --StartTime 1577808000000 --EventName ECS_unusual_log_in --OrderField ThreatScore --EntityUuid '6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000' --CurrentPage 1 --RoleFor 1130916744880000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --IncidentUuid '85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000' --AssetId '6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000'
description_en: Retrieves a list of threat analysis events
description_zh: 获取威胁分析与响应事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-cloud-siem-events --start-time 1577808000000 --end-time 1577808000000 --thread-level remind --event-name ECS_unusual_log_in --incident-uuid 85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000 --asset-id 6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000 --entity-uuid 6c740667-80b2-476d-8924-2e706feb0000 --status 0 --order-field ThreatScore --order desc --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudSiemEvents

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询事件的开始时间，精确到毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，精确到毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The threat level of the event. The value is a JSON array. Valid values:

serious: high

suspicious: medium

remind: low
parameters.help_zh:
事件威胁等级，格式为json数组。取值：
serious：高危
suspicious：中危
remind：低危
parameters.name: thread_level

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset that is associated with the event
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the entity that is associated with the event
parameters.name: entity_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The status of the event. Valid values:

0: unhandled

1: in progress

5: failed

10: handled
parameters.help_zh:
事件状态。取值：
0：未处理
1：处理中
5：处理失败
10：已处理
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The field to sort the event list by. Valid values:

GmtModified: Sorts by modification time. This is the default value.

ThreatScore: Sorts by threat score
parameters.help_zh:
事件列表排列字段。 取值：
GmtModified：基于事件产生事件排序（默认）
ThreatScore：基于事件威胁评分排序
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

desc: descending

asc: ascending
parameters.help_zh:
事件列表排列方向。 取值：
desc：降序排列
asc：升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号，大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts that are managed by the administrator account
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member. The administrator can use this ID to view the data of the member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis & Response is located. Select the region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
